findings.detail: The driver records chat/candidate/prepare statuses and Work/delivery values but does not assert their expected results before emitting status ok at line136. In a private protocol positive chat422 returns exit0/statusok; changing only chat to200 still returns exit0/statusok with refused.chat200. The outer submitted positive test asserts expected results, so its real positive pass remains valid; consumers must not use driver status alone as an acceptance verdict.
findings.impact: New sourceOnly tool can produce an apparent successful result after a behavior regression. This is not a demonstrated production authorization bypass or failure in E's existing package gate.
findings.next: Enforce requested expected user-flow outcomes or emit an explicit observation-only status that an independent consumer must validate. Add valid positive plus independent refusal/work/delivery mutations.

findings.detail: Readiness accepts any successful /v1/health at the requested port. It verifies only mode/startupMode, not this review's restoredReviewDigest, state/launcher/start identity or spawned consumer ownership, and does not reject child exit before declaring ready. The private mock probe's start entry is a no-op child while a separately owned pre-existing mock service supplies all successful reads; the driver still returns ok. File hashes record the requested entries but do not bind the serving process to them.
findings.impact: An occupied/reused endpoint can be mistaken for the supplied package's actual consumer. Hash binding in E remains additionally required; ordinary existing production main startup identity behavior is not invalidated.
findings.next: Use the package's trusted instance/process/root identity and exact prepared review identity, preserve lawful reuse, refuse unbound/different ready services, and never signal a resource merely because a port matches.

findings.detail: waitFor checks its wall-clock deadline only before awaiting an unbounded fetch. Every subsequent HTTP read/post also lacks an AbortSignal deadline. A connection that accepts but never completes can retain the operation beyond the advertised readiness/flow deadline; only the outer test timeout currently bounds it.
findings.evidence: Static source review only; no hanging live process probe was started.
findings.next: Add per-request abort deadlines bounded by an overall flow deadline, explicit early-child failure handling and exact owned-resource cleanup.

deliveryGaps.detail: The new test closes one ProductStore and constructs another in the same Node process. The dispatch intent states are demonstrated through a separate synthetic target, not the actual business dispatch transport. No new production bug is established.
